name: Spanish Common Words Set 4
description: This set is part of a larger collection of flashcards focused on common Spanish words, covering a mix of nouns, verbs, adjectives, and other essential parts of speech.

cards.sentence: Vamos a la playa la próxima semana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We are going to the beach next week.

cards.sentence: El mes de diciembre es frío.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The month of December is cold.

cards.sentence: Espera un minuto, por favor.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Wait a minute, please.

cards.sentence: Este es un momento importante para nosotros.
cards.sentenceTranslation: This is an important moment for us.

cards.sentence: Mis hijos van a la misma escuela.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My children go to the same school.

cards.sentence: Hay mucha gente en la calle hoy.
cards.sentenceTranslation: There are many people on the street today.

cards.sentence: Mi madre cocina muy bien.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My mother cooks very well.

cards.sentence: Su padre es muy trabajador.
cards.sentenceTranslation: His father is very hardworking.

cards.sentence: Tengo un hermano mayor.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I have an older brother.

cards.sentence: Mi hermana vive en otra ciudad.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My sister lives in another city.

cards.sentence: Me gusta la comida italiana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like Italian food.

cards.sentence: Necesito una bebida fría.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need a cold drink.

cards.sentence: La vida y la muerte son parte del ciclo natural.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Life and death are part of the natural cycle.

cards.sentence: No me digas una mentira, por favor.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Don't tell me a lie, please.

cards.sentence: El amor es el sentimiento más fuerte.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Love is the strongest feeling.

cards.sentence: El odio no lleva a ninguna parte.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Hate leads nowhere.

cards.sentence: Queremos vivir en paz.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We want to live in peace.

cards.sentence: La guerra es devastadora.
cards.sentenceTranslation: War is devastating.

cards.sentence: Mi abuela tiene buena salud a sus ochenta años.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My grandmother has good health at eighty years old.

cards.sentence: La educación es clave para el futuro.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Education is key for the future.

cards.sentence: Le encanta el arte moderno.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He loves modern art.

cards.sentence: Escucho música todos los días.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I listen to music every day.

cards.sentence: Anoche vi una película interesante.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Last night I watched an interesting movie.

cards.sentence: Mi deporte favorito es el fútbol.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My favorite sport is soccer.

cards.sentence: Los niños están jugando un juego de mesa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The children are playing a board game.

cards.sentence: Me gusta leer en la cama antes de dormir.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to read in bed before sleeping.

cards.sentence: La cocina de mi abuela es muy acogedora.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My grandmother's kitchen is very cozy.

cards.sentence: El baño está al final del pasillo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The bathroom is at the end of the hallway.

cards.sentence: Mi habitación tiene vistas al jardín.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My room has garden views.

cards.sentence: Cuál es tu color favorito?
cards.sentenceTranslation: What is your favorite color?

cards.sentence: Eso no tiene ningún sentido.
cards.sentenceTranslation: That makes no sense.

cards.sentence: Me interesa aprender sobre diferentes culturas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I'm interested in learning about different cultures.

cards.sentence: La ciencia nos ayuda a entender el mundo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Science helps us understand the world.

cards.sentence: La nueva tecnología está cambiando nuestras vidas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: New technology is changing our lives.

cards.sentence: Ella estudia política en la universidad.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She studies politics at university.

cards.sentence: La economía del país está creciendo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The country's economy is growing.

cards.sentence: Vamos al mercado a comprar frutas frescas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Let's go to the market to buy fresh fruit.

cards.sentence: El precio de la gasolina ha subido.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The price of gasoline has gone up.

cards.sentence: El cliente siempre tiene la razón.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The customer is always right.

cards.sentence: El servicio en este restaurante es excelente.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The service in this restaurant is excellent.

cards.sentence: Esperamos el resultado de la votación.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We await the result of the vote.

cards.sentence: Necesitamos un cambio en esta situación.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We need a change in this situation.

cards.sentence: Pienso mucho en el futuro.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I think a lot about the future.

cards.sentence: No podemos cambiar el pasado.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We cannot change the past.

cards.sentence: Vive el presente plenamente.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Live the present fully.

cards.sentence: Tengo mucha experiencia en este campo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I have a lot of experience in this field.

cards.sentence: La comunicación es esencial en una relación.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Communication is essential in a relationship.

cards.sentence: Necesito más información sobre el proyecto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need more information about the project.

cards.sentence: El desarrollo de la ciudad es muy rápido.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The city's development is very fast.

cards.sentence: La producción de vehículos aumentó este año.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Vehicle production increased this year.

cards.sentence: Necesito la dirección de tu casa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need your home address.

cards.sentence: Debemos encontrar una solución pronto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We must find a solution soon.

cards.sentence: Tenemos varias opciones para elegir.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We have several options to choose from.

cards.sentence: Voy a pedir una pizza para cenar.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I'm going to order a pizza for dinner.

cards.sentence: Puedes dejar tu mochila aquí.
cards.sentenceTranslation: You can leave your backpack here.

cards.sentence: No olvides tus llaves.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Don't forget your keys.

cards.sentence: Tuvo que rechazar la oferta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He had to reject the offer.

cards.sentence: No dudes en preguntar si tienes dudas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Don't hesitate to ask if you have doubts.

cards.sentence: Por favor, responde a mi pregunta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Please, answer my question.

cards.sentence: Necesito quitarme los zapatos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need to take off my shoes.

cards.sentence: Me gusta mucho leer libros.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I really like reading books.

cards.sentence: Voy a presentar mi proyecto mañana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I am going to present my project tomorrow.

cards.sentence: Es difícil controlar mis emociones a veces.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It's difficult to control my emotions sometimes.

cards.sentence: Todo depende de tu decisión.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Everything depends on your decision.

cards.irregularForms: produzco, produces, produce, producimos, producís, producen
cards.sentence: Esta fábrica produce coches eléctricos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: This factory produces electric cars.

cards.sentence: Espero recuperar mi energía pronto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I hope to recover my energy soon.

cards.sentence: El color rojo representa la pasión.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The color red represents passion.

cards.sentence: Quiero desarrollar nuevas habilidades.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I want to develop new skills.

cards.irregularForms: mantengo, mantienes, mantiene, mantenemos, mantenéis, mantienen
cards.sentence: Es importante mantener una dieta equilibrada.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It's important to maintain a balanced diet.

cards.irregularForms: protejo, proteges, protege, protegemos, protegéis, protegen
cards.sentence: Debemos proteger el medio ambiente.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We must protect the environment.

cards.sentence: La señal indica que hay una curva peligrosa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The sign indicates there is a dangerous curve.

cards.sentence: Siempre estoy dispuesto a aprender algo nuevo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I am always willing to learn something new.

cards.sentence: Ella va a enseñar español en la escuela.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She is going to teach Spanish at school.

cards.sentence: Espero que disfrutes tus vacaciones.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I hope you enjoy your vacation.

cards.sentence: Trato de evitar los problemas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I try to avoid problems.

cards.irregularForms: ofrezco, ofreces, ofrece, ofrecemos, ofrecéis, ofrecen
cards.sentence: Te puedo ofrecer una taza de café.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I can offer you a cup of coffee.

cards.sentence: Te prometo que lo haré.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I promise you I will do it.

cards.irregularForms: reúno, reúnes, reúne, reunimos, reunís, reúnen
cards.sentence: Necesitamos reunir más información.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We need to gather more information.

cards.irregularForms: envío, envías, envía, enviamos, enviáis, envían
cards.sentence: Voy a enviar un correo electrónico.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I am going to send an email.

cards.sentence: Puedes subir las escaleras.
cards.sentenceTranslation: You can go up the stairs.

cards.sentence: Vamos a bajar por el ascensor.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Let's go down by elevator.

cards.irregularForms: consigo, consigues, consigue, conseguimos, conseguís, consiguen
cards.sentence: Espero conseguir un buen trabajo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I hope to get a good job.

cards.irregularForms: conduzco, conduces, conduce, conducimos, conducís, conducen
cards.sentence: Me gusta conducir por la carretera.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to drive on the highway.

cards.irregularForms: traduzco, traduces, traduce, traducimos, traducís, traducen
cards.sentence: Puedes traducir este documento al inglés?
cards.sentenceTranslation: Can you translate this document to English?

cards.irregularForms: propongo, propones, propone, proponemos, proponéis, proponen
cards.sentence: Voy a proponer una nueva idea.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I'm going to propose a new idea.

cards.irregularForms: reconozco, reconoces, reconoce, reconocemos, reconocéis, reconocen
cards.sentence: Es difícil reconocerla con este disfraz.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It's hard to recognize her in this costume.

cards.irregularForms: dirijo, diriges, dirige, dirigimos, dirigís, dirigen
cards.sentence: Él va a dirigir la reunión.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He is going to direct the meeting.

cards.sentence: Debes aplicar estas reglas estrictamente.
cards.sentenceTranslation: You must apply these rules strictly.

cards.sentence: Esta situación es peor de lo que pensé.
cards.sentenceTranslation: This situation is worse than I thought.

cards.sentence: Es imposible terminarlo hoy.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It's impossible to finish it today.

cards.sentence: Estoy en contra de esa decisión.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I am against that decision.

cards.sentence: Vamos caminando hacia el parque.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We are walking towards the park.

cards.sentence: Conseguimos el objetivo mediante trabajo duro.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We achieved the goal through hard work.

cards.sentence: Tras la lluvia, salió el sol.
cards.sentenceTranslation: After the rain, the sun came out.

cards.sentence: Puedes elegir cualquier libro que quieras.
cards.sentenceTranslation: You can choose any book you want.

cards.sentence: Tu mochila está ahí, en la silla.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Your backpack is there, on the chair.

cards.sentence: El coche está aparcado delante de la casa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The car is parked in front of the house.

cards.sentence: El libro está encima de la mesa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The book is on top of the table.

cards.sentence: Normalmente, ceno a las ocho.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Normally, I have dinner at eight.

cards.sentence: Simplemente no entiendo por qué lo hizo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I simply don't understand why he did it.

cards.sentence: Tengo bastante dinero para esto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I have enough money for this.

cards.sentence: Estoy totalmente de acuerdo contigo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I totally agree with you.

cards.sentence: Quizás vaya al cine esta noche.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Perhaps I'll go to the cinema tonight.

cards.sentence: Llegaremos aproximadamente a las cinco.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We will arrive at approximately five.

cards.sentence: Hemos terminado el trabajo completamente.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We have completed the work completely.

cards.sentence: Eso es precisamente lo que quería decir.
cards.sentenceTranslation: That's precisely what I wanted to say.

cards.sentence: El día anterior llovió mucho.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The previous day it rained a lot.

cards.sentence: Analizaremos los resultados posterior a la prueba.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We will analyze the results subsequent to the test.

cards.sentence: Hoy es un día muy especial para mí.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Today is a very special day for me.

cards.sentence: Es una decisión personal.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It's a personal decision.

cards.sentence: Es natural sentirse cansado después de un largo viaje.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It's natural to feel tired after a long journey.

cards.sentence: Prefiero las flores naturales a las artificiales.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I prefer natural flowers over artificial ones.

cards.sentence: Necesito aprender el español básico.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need to learn basic Spanish.

cards.sentence: El círculo es completo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The circle is complete.
